tsim-cpu-1t.device: cpu (Ryzen 9 9900X), pinned by tsim-dev to one core
tsim-cpu-1t.settings: tsim-dev bench (dev/tsim_dev in the same checkout), uv-synced worktree src/tsim-dm

output_contract.on: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds
output_contract.off: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds

tsim-cpu-mt.device: cpu, numba threads = 12, pinned by tsim-dev to 12 logical CPUs on 12 distinct physical cores

output_contract.on: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds
output_contract.off: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds

tsim-cuda.settings: tsim-dev bench --device gpu (worktree src/tsim-cuda, uv sync --extra cuda); allow_large_shared_memory workaround not needed by tsim-dev

output_contract.on: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds
output_contract.off: tsim-dev bench: detector sampler, bit-packed rows (kept rows only), calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds

clifft-1t.settings: compile(default_hir_pass_manager() + ActiveWidthSchedulePass()); batch_size chosen by batch_size='tune' once at warm-up

output_contract.on: sample_survivors(keep_records=False): counts only (passed shots, per-observable ones); batch_size from batch_size='tune' at warm-up
output_contract.off: sample(): unpacked uint8 measurements, detectors, observables; batch_size from batch_size='tune' at warm-up

output_contract.on: sample_survivors(keep_records=False): counts only (passed shots, per-observable ones); batch_size from batch_size='tune' at warm-up
output_contract.off: sample(): unpacked uint8 measurements, detectors, observables; batch_size from batch_size='tune' at warm-up

symft-1t.version: symft 2026.10.8 (PyPI wheel; = SOFT release v0.1.0 @ 81d28499, github.com/haoliri0/SOFT)
symft-1t.settings: post on: compile_counts_sampler(postselect_detectors=True, cpu_backend='compiled'); post off: compile_sampler(batch=True) measurement records + stim m2d

output_contract.on: compile_counts_sampler(cpu_backend='compiled' if eligible): counts only (accepted shots, observable-0 logical errors)
output_contract.off: compile_sampler(batch=True).sample(bit_packed=True) measurement records, converted to bit-packed detectors+observables by stim's m2d converter (raw parities; conversion time included). SymFT's counts sampler without postselection falls back to its slower legacy path, so this per-shot path is its fastest here

symft-mt.settings: post on: counts sampler threads=12 (compiled backend supports only threads=1, so the legacy multithreaded path); post off: 12 Python threads with one compiled sampler each

output_contract.on: compile_counts_sampler(cpu_backend='compiled' if eligible): counts only (accepted shots, observable-0 logical errors)
output_contract.off: compile_sampler(batch=True).sample(bit_packed=True) measurement records, converted to bit-packed detectors+observables by stim's m2d converter (raw parities; conversion time included). SymFT's counts sampler without postselection falls back to its slower legacy path, so this per-shot path is its fastest here

xtim-1t.settings: compile_twirl_sampler(text) (default selfcheck window runs in the warm-up call); sample(n, threads=1[, postselect=mask])

output_contract.on: TwirlSampler.sample: Stim b8 bit-packed detectors + observables (relative to noiseless reference); postselect=mask (kept rows only)
output_contract.off: TwirlSampler.sample: Stim b8 bit-packed detectors + observables (relative to noiseless reference)

output_contract.on: TwirlSampler.sample: Stim b8 bit-packed detectors + observables (relative to noiseless reference); postselect=mask (kept rows only)
output_contract.off: TwirlSampler.sample: Stim b8 bit-packed detectors + observables (relative to noiseless reference)

magna-1t.settings: native task via ~/sim-comparison/magna_convert.py; run(compiled, shots=n), physical sampling; options of the packaged examples (max_path_bits 65536, max_doubled_path_bits 131072, max_quotient_rank 12, max_terms 4096)

output_contract.on: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows
output_contract.off: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows

magna-mt.settings: Magna has no thread option: 12 forked processes sharing the compiled circuit, shots split evenly

output_contract.on: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows
output_contract.off: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows

magna-cuda.version: magna-quantum 0.2.0 @ e466ec6 with cuda12 extra, cupy-cuda12x 14.2.0 (NVRTC kernels compiled at first call)

output_contract.on: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows
output_contract.off: Magna native task: exact per-draw acceptance (POSTSELECT on the manifest mask) and error mass (any OBSERVABLE flipped from its noiseless value); counts only, no per-shot rows

notes.shots_per_s: attempted shots per second, kept or not
notes.kept: fraction of attempted shots surviving postselection
notes.rates: detection_rate: mean over kept shots and noiselessly-deterministic detectors of a detection event; observable_rate: mean observable flip among kept shots (null where the simulator returns no per-shot rows; Tsim's rates come from a separate Tsim CPU reference run)
notes.suspect: a sanity statistic (kept, rates) differs from the Tsim reference (or xtim/Magna where Tsim cannot run) by > 5 standard errors; null = nothing comparable
notes.timing: Tsim: tsim-dev bench (calls calibrated to ~0.3 s and <= ~256 MB, median of 3 fresh-process rounds). Others: n doubles from 64 until a call takes >= 2 s (or 2 GiB output), best of 3 calls at that n. compile_s and warmup_s are excluded from shots_per_s. 300 s per cell, systemd MemoryMax per worker
notes.isolation: every timed cell ran alone (1t pinned to one physical core, mt to the 12 physical cores); only failed 1t cells (timeout/OOM/unsupported) come from an 8-way parallel pass
notes.details: results_full.json has standard errors, z-scores, output contracts per cell, raw errors
